area: Information architecture and UX of the final app (internal app + supplier portal), as mirrored by the localhost prototype
summary:
The prototype has the right screens, but the menus still repeat themselves and carry demo leftovers.

**Repeated or redundant menu entries**
- 'Our understanding' is in four menus (catalog.ts:341,358,399,427), on a top-bar button (Shells.tsx:54-58) and in a drawer (AssumptionsDrawer.tsx). The drawer still marks every assumption 'To confirm'.
- The business owner's 'Operations' item opens the RMM dashboard (catalog.ts:425).
- RMM has 'New case' three times: in the menu, on the dashboard and on Cases.
- RMM sees the same cases in three lists: Dashboard 'My cases', 'My reviews' and Cases filtered to owner=me.
- For Customs and Legal, 'Informed cases' and 'All cases' are almost the same list, because K7 and K8 are in every case (catalog.ts:110-111).
- The supplier sees the same work three times: request groups on My requests, the Tasks page, and the questions inside a request.

**The same information shown twice**
- The case page has 7 tabs. Scope and Questionnaire both list the active sections.
- The audit trail's 'Reconstruct a case' repeats the case page's Overview, Open points, Documents and Audit content.
- The admin's Questionnaire page repeats the rule table's version cards, but publishing happens only on the rule table.
- Stat tiles repeat the tab counts on My reviews, Informed cases and the supplier home.
- Dashboard tiles repeat report KPIs (lead time, first-time-right).

**Copy that contradicts the binding decisions**
- 'Review version' still appears in about 20 places, although BRM v2 REQ-PROC-016 says there is no review version.
- Documents show version numbers, although REQ-PROC-029 v2 says documents are not versioned.
- Confirmed assumptions still read 'to be confirmed': AS-06, AS-07, AS-08, and AS-02 in the RMM attention text. The supplier-facing questionnaire says 'Our assumption AS-06, to be confirmed' (ConfigQuestions.tsx:42).

**Demo-only widgets**
- The sidebar 'Ending:' box, 'Reset demo data', the 'Prototype' badge and the footers.
- Prototype notes (DemoNote) throughout.
- A disabled 'Download PDF' on the supplier side.
- A video-guide card.
- Empty states that say 'switch to role X'.

**Edge cases that break with the empty start**
- Supplier Help shows the OLD flow (basic questions, then scope release) when the supplier has no request (SupplierHelp.tsx:99-100).
- The Help FAQ points to a 'Corrections' page that the prototype menu does not have (SupplierHelp.tsx:84).
- With zero cases, reports show 0 days lead time, 0% first-time-right and 100% on time.
- The empty event log says 'No event matches these filters' and offers 'Clear filters'.
- Every landing page shows rows of zero tiles and empty charts.
- RMM can make Jan Petersen the case owner, but no persona exists for him, so his review and mails cannot be reached.

**Missing screens and actions**
- A Suppliers master screen.
- A mailbox per person (simulated e-mail).
- The on-screen final document, created at the final release.
- Edit and close of an open point by the person who raised it (AS-08).
- 'Changed after completeness' markers for reviewers (AS-03, REQ-PROC-031).
- Editing a case's details and contacts mid-case.
- Reassigning a review task.

**Recommended final menus** (≤3 items for most roles):

| Role | Menu |
|---|---|
| RMM | Home · Cases · Suppliers |
| Departments | My reviews · Cases |
| Customs and Legal | Cases (their informed list) |
| Admin | Rules · Questionnaire · Section owners · Notifications · Suppliers (read-only) |
| Auditor | Audit trail · Cases · Rules (read-only) |
| Business owner | Reports · Cases |
| Supplier | My requests (tasks merged in) · Help |

The mailbox, 'view as' and reset to the empty start become one discreet demo menu outside the app menus.

items.details:
**Routes:** /suppliers, /suppliers/:id, and an 'Add supplier' modal.

**List columns:** Supplier · DUNS · Country · Type (Manufacturer or Distributor) · Contacts (active/total) · Open cases · Status (Active or Inactive) · Source ('Imported' or 'Added in app'). Search by name or DUNS.

**Detail:**
- Company card: legal name, DUNS, type, country, address, optional SAP vendor no. (manual, AS-10).
- Contacts table: name, job title, e-mail, 'Can give confirmations' (completeness and final release), portal access ('Invited <date>' or 'Not invited yet'), status. Actions: Add contact, Edit, Deactivate. There is never a delete.
- 'Cases' table for this supplier.
- A history of changes.

**Who may edit:** RMM edits. Admin, auditor and owner read only.

**Validation and edge cases:**
- Name, country and type are required.
- DUNS has exactly 9 digits and must be unique. On a duplicate, the warning links to the existing supplier.
- A contact e-mail must be valid and unique within the supplier.
- A supplier needs at least one active contact before New case offers it.
- Deactivating a contact who is on running cases lists those cases and asks RMM to replace the contact (see EDGE-06).
- An inactive supplier is hidden in New case; its running cases continue.
- A new contact appears at once in the demo 'view as' list (EDGE-08).

**Entry points:** New case shows 'Add a new supplier' under the supplier select; after saving, it returns with the new supplier selected.

items.details:
**Where:** an envelope icon in the top bar of both shells, next to the person chip, with an unread badge. It opens a right-hand drawer titled 'Mailbox · <name> <e-mail>', with the subtitle 'Simulated e-mail'.

It is NOT a menu item, because in the final app these mails land in Outlook. The menus stay the final app's.

**Layout:** list newest first, unread in bold. The reading pane shows From ('Beiersdorf CIQ <no-reply@…>'), To, Subject, time, body, and a deep-link button: 'Open in CIQ' for internal mails, 'Open in the Supplier Portal' for supplier mails.

**One mail per event (R-1, Thomas 13 Oct):**
- Open point raised: to all supplier contacts on the case. Neutral text, no internal content.
- Answered: to the raiser, and to the responsible person if that is someone else.
- Edited by the raiser: to the supplier contacts.
- Closed by the raiser: to the supplier contacts, 'no action needed'.
- Returned for a new round: to the supplier contacts.

**Recommended extras (question to Thomas):**
- Case invitation, to the selected contacts.
- Final-release request, to the supplier contacts.
- 'Final document ready', to the RMM owner (links to SCR-03).
- Cancellation, to the supplier contacts.

Every mail is also logged in the case audit as 'Notified …' (REQ-CTL-010).

Marking a mail read happens per person. The reset to the empty start clears all mailboxes.

items.details:
**Route:** /cases/:id/final-document. Internal roles only. Print-friendly A4 layout with a 'Print / save as PDF' button.

**Header:** logo, 'CIQ final document', CIQ ID, trade name, INCI, BDF material no., supplier, generated at (= the release time), and the note 'Created automatically at the supplier's final release. Cannot be changed.'

**Content:**
1. Released answers by section, including the metadata answers and the components table.
2. Evidence list: file name, section and field, uploaded by, upload date.
3. Every open point as text: its reference, who raised it, then each round in order (question, answer, return or accept, with who and when). Attachments are listed by name only.
4. Confirmations: completeness; each review completion by RMM and each department (name, e-mail, time); the final release.

RMES, findings and internal notes are excluded.

**Linked from:**
- the case page's completed banner;
- an Overview card 'Final document';
- the RMM owner's mail;
- the audit event 'Final document created'.

No button exists to create it.

**Edge cases:** a cancelled case has no document. Only a completed case shows the link.

items.details:
**Who:** only the raiser, on 'My open points', at any status before it is closed. Others' points stay read-only, and the case page's Open points tab is read-only.

**Edit:** question, supplier justification, due date, responsible person and reference. The reason for the change is required. It records an 'Edited' round entry with who and when, and sends a mail to the supplier contacts (SCR-02).

**Close:** withdraw with a reason, or accept. It sends a mail to the supplier contacts.

- the supplier task shows 'Updated by Beiersdorf <date>' and the new text;

**End-to-end from the empty start:**

2. RMM creates a case; the invitation mails arrive.
3. The new contact, via 'view as', fills in and confirms.

proposals:
## 1. Final menus per role

The demo controls sit outside every menu (see §4).

| Role (person) | Landing | Menu, in order | Removed from today's menu |
|---|---|---|---|
| Raw Material Manager (Katrin Vogel; Jan Petersen) | Home `/rmm` | Home · Cases · Suppliers | My reviews (folded into Home and the case page), New case (now a button), Reports, Our understanding |
| Regulatory / Safety / QM / Microbiology / Sustainability reviewer | My reviews `/review` | My reviews · Cases | Our understanding |
| Customs & Trade Compliance (informed); Legal / IP (informed) | Cases `/informed` | Cases | All cases (the same list, since K7 and K8 apply to every case) |
| Business administrator | Rules `/admin/rules` | Rules · Questionnaire · Section owners · Notifications · Suppliers (read-only) | Our understanding |
| Auditor | Audit trail `/audit` | Audit trail · Cases · Rules (read-only) | none (the Reconstruct tab moves to the case History tab) |
| Business owner | Reports `/reports` | Reports · Cases | Operations (a copy of the RMM dashboard), Our understanding |
| Supplier contact (Elena Márquez, Ravi Menon, and contacts added in the master) | My requests `/portal` | My requests · Help | Tasks (merged into My requests; the route stays for the live portal) |

**Pages that are not in the menus:**
- the case page `/cases/:id`, with tabs Overview · Questionnaire · Open points · Documents · Internal notes · History;
- the review `/review/:caseId`, with tabs Questionnaire · RMES (SAF and REG only), and on the right rail My open points and Internal notes, with the complete panel below;
- New case `/cases/new`;
- the supplier detail `/suppliers/:id`;
- the final document `/cases/:id/final-document`;
- the supplier request `/portal/case/:id`;
- the stand-alone call page `/understanding/call`.

## 2. Landing pages: zero cases vs live cases

- **RMM Home**
  - *Zero:* greeting and date. One card, 'Start your first CIQ case', with a 4-step strip (Start → supplier fills in → reviews → final release), the primary button [New case] and the secondary [Suppliers (1)]. No tiles, charts or activity.
  - *Live:*
    1. 4 operational tiles: My open cases · With supplier · With Beiersdorf · Overdue open points. Each opens Cases with a filter.
    2. 'Needs your action', with chips: Department rejected · Overdue at supplier · My review · Final release pending · No activity · Origin without rules.
    3. 'My cases': Case · Phase/waiting on · My review · Open points · Due.
    4. On the right: 'Bottlenecks by review' (only while a case is in review) and 'Recent activity'.
  - *One case in the supplier step:* 'Nothing waits on you. 1 case is with the supplier', plus the case row.
- **Department My reviews**
  - *Zero:* a single empty state explaining when a task appears and that an e-mail comes with it.
  - *Live:* tabs To review / Waiting for supplier / Completed with counts, one inline alert ('2 answers to check · 1 overdue'), and the table. There are no stat cards.
- **Customs and Legal Cases**
  - *Zero:* 'No CIQ cases yet. K7 is part of every case.'
  - *Live:* Active/Closed/All, with the K7 or K8 status column. A row opens the read-only case page at that section.
- **Admin Rules:** the same with or without cases ('0 cases on this version'). Notifications shows static templates, so nothing depends on cases.
- **Auditor Audit trail**
  - *Zero:* 'No events yet. The trail starts with the first case.' No filters show.
  - *Live:* filters and the event table. A case ID opens the case History tab, which starts with the 'who assessed what' summary.
- **Business owner Reports**
  - *Zero:* the title 'CIQ performance', tiles showing '—', and one line, 'Reports fill as cases run'.
  - *Live:* sections Open cases now (pipeline and bottlenecks, moved from the dashboard) · Lead time (after the first completed case) · Intake and workload · Clarifications and supplier performance. The 'Business case' section goes.
- **Supplier My requests**
  - *Zero:* 'Welcome, Elena', then 'No requests yet…' with a Help link. No tiles.
  - *Live:* 'Your tasks (n)' rows (answer in the drawer, or open), then the requests grouped Needs your action · With Beiersdorf · Closed.
- **Supplier Help:** always the current flow (STEPS_LIVE). The contacts card says 'appears with your first request' while there is none.

## 3. New screens

**Suppliers master** (SCR-01)
- *List:* Supplier · DUNS · Country · Type · Contacts · Open cases · Status · Source.
- *Detail:* company card, a contacts table (name, title, e-mail, can confirm, portal access, status), the supplier's cases, and a history.
- *Rights and rules:* RMM edits; contacts are deactivated, never deleted. DUNS has 9 digits and must be unique. A supplier needs at least one active contact before a case can use it. Deactivating a contact on a running case asks RMM to replace them.
- *Entry:* 'Add a new supplier' from New case.

**Mailbox** (SCR-02)
- An envelope with an unread badge in both top bars opens a drawer, 'Mailbox · <person> · Simulated e-mail'. It holds one mail per open-point event (raised, answered, edited, closed, returned), each with a deep link.
- Supplier mails are neutral. Every mail is logged on the case.
- Recommended extras: invitation, release request, final document to RMM, cancellation.

**Final document** (SCR-03)
- Created automatically at the final release. It is a printable on-screen page, internal roles only, and cannot be changed.
- It holds the answers, the evidence list with upload dates, every open-point thread as text with who and when (attachments by name only), all confirmations and the CIQ ID.
- Linked from the case banner, Overview, the RMM mail and the audit event.

## 4. Demo controls (outside the app)

The person chip menu has a muted 'Demo' section:
- **View as:** people grouped by role and by supplier, with task and unread counts.
- **Open mailbox.**
- **Show prototype notes:** off for the call; it hides every DemoNote.
- **Reset to empty start:** behind a confirm dialog; it returns to the role holders and Solvaro Oleochemicals with no cases.

**Removed:**
- the 'Ending:' box;
- the sidebar 'Reset demo data';
- the 'Prototype' badge;
- the 'Prototype by Kissflow' footers;
- the 'External access' badge;
- the 'Our understanding' button and drawer.

## 5. Questions for Thomas (my default, if he gives no answer)

1. Reports and audit trail: should the owner AND the auditor see both, or is it split as above? Default: split (owner Reports, auditor Audit trail).
2. Suppliers: may the admin edit them, or only read (app-plan-v4 F1 says RMM writes)? Default: the admin reads only.
3. Supplier menu: merge Tasks into My requests, or keep Tasks and drop the groups? Default: merge.
4. Does the supplier get a copy of the final document? Default: no (D-3 says it goes to RMM).
5. Mailbox: also invitation, release request, final document and cancellation mails, or only the four open-point mails? Default: include them; Kissflow sends these natively.
6. Drop 'My reviews' from the RMM menu? Default: yes; the Home page and the case page cover it.
7. Remove 'Business case' from Reports? Default: yes.
8. The live portal's Notices and Corrections pages (src/portal/supplier/supplierRoutes.tsx:15-16): with AS-03, the supplier edits directly until the release, and after it nothing changes (REQ-PROC-043). Default: the final portal has no Corrections or Notices, and the CIQ Change Request process (app-plan-v4 P3) is dropped. The live portal stays as it is until the rework.

## 6. Build order for tonight (lowest risk first)

1. catalog.ts menus and labels, removing Our understanding (App.tsx:71, Shells.tsx, AssumptionsDrawer).
2. The demo menu and the reset to the empty start.
3. Copy fixes: review version, the AS texts, Help, no-access states.
4. Empty states on every landing page and the zero-data metrics.
5. The Suppliers master.
6. The mailbox and the open-point edit and close.
7. The final document.
8. Tab merges: Scope into Questionnaire, Reconstruct into History, the Informed drawer.
9. The stat-card and tile de-duplication.

Do not touch src/workbench. Leave the live-portal routes (src/portal/supplier/supplierRoutes.tsx) and the legacy branches of SupplierCase and SupplierHelp in place, behind props, so `node scripts/harness-portal.mjs` stays green.

## 7. Tests

The menu-contract unit test, render tests at the empty start for every role and route, and the end-to-end walkthrough are as described in TEST-01.
